blockers.match: Role `alarm-disk-free` is bound in source/prod but not in target/prod

blockers.match: Log route `audit-logs` must keep logs 400 days; target/prod's `audit-logs` keeps them 90
blockers.planted: the target's audit workspace keeps logs 90 days, short of the 400-day obligation

blockers.match: Role `identity-idm` is bound in source/prod but not in target/prod
blockers.planted: the target doesn't bind the IDM role the source runs (nobody records what acts as it: A39)

blockers.match: Role `forwarder-corp.example-aero.internal` is bound in source/prod but not in target/prod
blockers.planted: the source forwards the AD domain to the domain controllers; nothing in the target does

blockers.match: Role `acl-ds` is bound in source/prod but not in target/prod
blockers.planted: the source's network ACL on the directory subnet has no counterpart in the target (Azure has none: its NSGs do that work); decide, and record why

blockers.match: Data store `corp-directory` has withheld credentials but no credential role
blockers.planted: imported corporate directory store names no secret

blockers.match: Volume `volume-ds-data` is 500 GB in source/prod but 256 GB in target/prod
blockers.planted: the target's directory data volume came from a sandbox template: what PingDS keeps doesn't fit

blockers.match: Role `snapshots-daily` is bound in source/prod but not in target/prod
blockers.planted: the target binds no snapshot policy (the volume check says what it loses: A72)

blockers.match: Role `backup-daily` is bound in source/prod but not in target/prod
blockers.planted: the target runs no AWS Backup-like plan for the directory's data (its cost is the platform team's to approve)

blockers.match: Role `backup-vault` is bound in source/prod but not in target/prod
blockers.planted: the target has no backup vault

actions.match: `flow-vnet` keeps flow logs 14 days in target/prod
actions.planted: the target's flow log (still to be built by the network team) keeps 14 days; the source keeps 30

actions.match: no route sends internet egress through `egress-firewall`
actions.planted: the target's route table sends internet traffic straight to the NAT gateway, around the hub firewall whose domain rules the stack relies on

actions.match: Data store `corp-directory` reaches a fixed host
actions.planted: PingFederate's corporate directory store lists two domain controllers, the same from every environment (its fix records both, in order, as one role's hosts)

actions.match: Database `pf-grants-db` keeps backups 14 days in source/prod but 7
actions.planted: the target's grant database keeps backups 7 days where the source keeps 14

actions.match: Database `pf-grants-db` has deletion protection in source/prod but not
actions.planted: nothing stops the target's grant database being deleted by mistake (no lock)

actions.match: Object store `backup-target` locks objects (compliance 35 days) in source/prod
actions.planted: the target's backup container (CHG-2017) has no immutability policy: a backup can be deleted early
nothing copies the target's backups to another region; the source replicates to us-west-2

actions.match: Before cutover, restore `volume-ds-data`'s data in target/prod
actions.planted: nothing shows the target can recover the directory's data: it has no restore test (the source's passed in August)
the target snapshots nothing of the directory's data volume (on Azure that is a disk backup plan in a Backup vault)
nothing backs the target's directory data volume up

actions.match: Snapshot policy `snapshots-daily` copies each snapshot to us-west-2 in source/prod
actions.planted: the target's disk backup (CHG-2019) keeps snapshots in its own region: Azure disk backup can't copy them

actions.match: Recovery objective `directory-data` allows `volume-ds-data` to lose 60 minutes of changes; in target/prod
actions.planted: nothing keeps the target's directory data outside its region: no standby replicates from it, and its disk backup (CHG-2019) stays in eastus2 (Azure disk backup can't copy)
the warm standby on Google Cloud still stands by for production on AWS: after cutover nothing stands by for the target (the fix re-points it)

actions.match: Recovery objective `directory-data` wants `volume-ds-data` back within 120 minutes; in target/prod
actions.planted: nothing shows how fast the target recovers the directory's data (once CHG-2019 backs it up, the restore-test check asks for the test instead: A73)

actions.match: Tag `DataClassification` (tag rule data-classification) has no value in target/prod
actions.planted: the target environment records no data classification, so its resources would go without the tag policy's DataClassification tag
